items.message: The `review-${ISSUE}.json` cassette path in the harvest step is constructed from the `ISSUE` environment variable (set to `github.event.issue.number`), which is safe — but the step lacks the `if: ${{ !github.event.pull_request.head.repo.fork }}` guard present in the lockstep.yml harvest step. This is not an injection risk (the value is a number passed through an env var, not interpolated into the shell string), but it means the harvest step runs on fork-originated comments where the artifact upl…[truncated]

The `git check-ignore` subprocess call passes `str(directory)` as a path argument after `--`. On all supported platforms `directory` is derived from `root / CASSETTE_DIR` where `root` comes from the caller — no shell is involved and the `--` separator is present, so a path beginning with a dash cannot be misread as a flag. I see no exploitable path here; noting it because the diff comment itself calls this out as something a previous review raised, confirming the fix is in place.
